reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that advertisements are becoming increasingly common in our daily life. From my perspective, this development has both positive and negative effects, which will be discussed below.
            From consumers perspective, advertisements can bring a truly convenient and helpful buying can bring a truly convenient and helpful buying experience. Unlike decades ago, when people largely relied on local brands, consumers nowadays can see advertisements on social networking platforms, television and street billboards. As a result, they are exposed to a wide range of goods available on the market and can make wiser purchasing choices and decisions. In addition, on a far wider societal scale, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. Engaging content and appealing visual effects can increase customers demand and purchasing power. Therefore, companies may increase their production and create may increase their production and create more employment opportunities, while more revenue can also be generated for the state budget.
           However, the development of advertising also has some negative effects. First, advertisements may lure people into buying things that they may not actually need. This tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities and their strong influence on consumer. As a result, people may consider promoted products more trustworthy and desirable and develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits, even when they are not really interested in them. Second, advertising messages can contribute to the development of a materialistic society. Because advertisements constantly repeat persuasive messages, people may gradually believe that owning certain products can help them achieve comfort and happiness in life. Consequently, they may always want to buy more expensive items, while valuable spiritual and personal can become less important.
            In conclusion, advertising can help consumers make better purchasing decisions and contribute to grow economic. In addition, it can also encourage wasteful consumption and make society more materialistic.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
It is argued that advertisements are becoming increasingly common in daily life. From my perspective, this development has both positive and negative effects, which will be discussed below.

The development of advertising is beneficial for both consumers and the wider economy. From consumers' perspective, advertisements can bring a truly convenient and helpful buying experience. Unlike decades ago, when people largely relied on local brands, consumers nowadays can see advertisements on social networking platforms, television and street billboards. As a result, they are exposed to a wide range of goods available on the market and can make wiser purchasing decisions. In addition, on a far wider societal scale, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. Engaging content and appealing visual effects can increase customers' demand and purchasing power. Therefore, companies may increase their production and create more employment opportunities, while more revenue can also be generated for the state budget.

However, the development of advertising also has some negative effects. First, advertisements may lure people into buying things that they may not actually need. This tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities and their strong influence on consumers. As a result, people may consider promoted products more trustworthy and desirable and develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits, even when they are not really interested in them. Second, advertising messages can contribute to the development of a materialistic society. Because advertisements constantly repeat persuasive messages, people may gradually believe that owning certain products can help them achieve comfort and happiness in life. Consequently, they may always want to buy more expensive items, while valuable spiritual and personal values can become less important.

In conclusion, advertising can help consumers make better purchasing decisions and contribute to economic growth. In addition, it can also encourage wasteful consumption and make society more materialistic.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
There is a view that the media should report more stories about positive events and achievements. I disagree with this opinion because, although good news has some benefits, bad news is also necessary for society.
                  On the one hand, reporting good news more frequently can help people develop a more optimistic view of the world and their lives. Positive stories can give people hope and encourage them to overcome difficulties in their daily lives. For example, Nick Vujicic, a man born without limb, became a world famous motivational speaker and inspired many people by facing numerous challenges. However, it is not practical for the media to focus on good news because people are naturally attracted to breaking and shocking events, such as scandals and natural disasters, so news companies may lose profits and viewer.
                    On the other hand, bad news is important because it constantly warns people about existing and possible problems in society. When people are exposed to information about dangerous behavior. For instance, if the media frequently reports tragic deaths caused by drunk driving, people may be more likely to avoid drinking before driving. Therefore, reporting bad news can help the public recognise dangers and prevent similar problems in the future.
                     In conclusion, I believe that the media should not report more good news because negative stories also play an important role in society.
reviews.overall: Em đã chọn đúng hướng không đồng ý, thừa nhận lợi ích của tin tốt rồi nêu hai lý do phản đối. Tuy nhiên, Body 1 chưa có câu chủ đề bao quát; ví dụ Nick và chuỗi người xem giảm → doanh thu giảm → nguy cơ đóng cửa còn thiếu bước. Body 2 mới nhắc chung tai nạn do lái xe say rượu, chưa kể và phân tích đủ ví dụ được giao. Bài có 226 từ, thiếu 24 từ; câu bắt đầu bằng When cũng chưa hoàn chỉnh. Cô yêu cầu em sửa các chỗ này và nộp lại.

Admittedly, reporting more good news has certain advantages, but the proposal overlooks a practical difficulty. However, people are often drawn to breaking or shocking events, such as political scandals and natural disasters. If news companies focus too heavily on good news, they may fail to attract enough viewers or readers. This loss of audience could reduce their revenue and eventually cause some outlets to close.

This can be seen in a report about a tragic accident in which a family of four lost their lives because the father was driving under the influence of alcohol. When people are regularly exposed to such reports, they may be more likely to avoid drunk driving and to dissuade friends or relatives from doing so. By reporting deaths caused by dangerous driving, media companies can therefore help the public recognise risks and prevent similar tragedies.

In conclusion, despite the potential benefits of positive stories, I remain convinced that the media should not give them more space at the expense of negative news.

reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Some scientists believe that intelligent life may exist on other planets and that humans should send messages to contact them, while other consider this is dangerous idea. I agree with the second view because, although contacting other forms of life may provide valuable knowledge, it could also put humanity at serious risk.
                      On the one hand, searching for intelligent life outside the Earth may bring important benefits to humanity. There are currently many serious problems that seem difficult to sole, such as global warming, rising sea levels or animal extinction, which may eventually threaten the future of our race. If humans could contact an advanced civilisation that had successfully dealt with these problems, it might share valuable knowledge with us and help us avoid similar threats. Therefore, the possibility of studying useful knowledge from other life on other planets is one reason why some scientists support sending messages to intelligent life forms.
                       On the other hand, contacting other civilisation could be extremely dangerous because our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration. If an alien had technology far more advanced that ours, humans might be unable to protect themselves against a possible attack or invasion. Such a civilisation could use its superior technology to control or harm humanity, while we would have little ability to resist it. As a result, sending messages to unknown life forms could create a new serious threat that human are not prepared to deal with.
                         In conclusion, although contacting with alien on other planets could provide valuable knowledge, i still believe that it is a bad idea because the possible risks to humanity are too big.

Body 2 còn thiếu chứng cứ về Sao Hỏa và bước giải thích khả năng con người bị lợi dụng; em cũng cần tách rõ ý này khỏi nguy cơ xâm lược. reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising plays an important role in promoting products and services. However, some people believe that powerful advertisements can have negative effects on individuals. This essay will discuss the harmful effects of advertising and suggest some possible solutions to this problem.
                 There are several ways in which advertising can negatively affect people. First, advertisements often encourage people to buy unnecessary products by using attractive images and persuasive messages. As a result, people may spend too much money on things they do not really need, which can lead to financial problems. For example, some young people buy expensive clothes or electronic devices because they want to follow the latest trends. Second, advertising can create unrealistic expectations about beauty and lifestyle. When people see images of perfect bodies or luxurious lives, they may feel dissatisfied with their own appearance or living conditions. This can reduce their confidence and negatively affect their mental health.
                  Several solutions can be implemented to minimize these harmful effects. First, governments should introduce stricter laws  for advertising, especially advertisements that contain false information or make unrealistic promises. Companies should be required to provide accurate information about their products so that consumers can make better decisions. Second, schools and families should help people develop critical thinking skills. For instance, students should learn to recognize persuasive advertising techniques and understand that advertisements are designed to increase sales rather than simply provide information. In addition, individuals should compare products carefully and consider their demand before making a purchase.
                   In conclusion, powerful advertising can cause financial problems and reduce people's confidence by encouraging unnecessary spending and creating unrealistic expectations. To reduce these negative effects, governments should control misleading advertisements, while schools, families and individuals should raise awareness about advertising techniques.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ 288 từ, chia đúng hai đoạn thân bài để trả lời hai câu hỏi và giải thích rõ cả việc mua sắm lãng phí lẫn áp lực từ hình ảnh lý tưởng. Tuy nhiên, phần giải pháp chưa chỉ rõ biện pháp nào xử lý áp lực về ngoại hình và lối sống; quy định về thông tin sai cũng cần nối cụ thể với tác hại đã nêu. Mở bài còn diễn đạt quá sát câu hỏi. Cô yêu cầu em sửa các mối nối này và thay cụm “consider their demand” bằng cách nói đúng nghĩa.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people consider video games a form of entertainment or even a useful way to learn, while others believe that they have negative effects on players. From my perspective, the disadvantages of video games outweigh their benefits because excessive gaming can harm people's health and education.
              Admittedly, video games offer certain recreational and educational advantages. They allow players to explore virtual worlds, experience exciting activities and relax after a long day. In addition, some games require players to make quick decisions, which can improve problem-solving skills and teamwork. However, these benefits are not unique to gaming. For example, team sports and debate clubs can also develop similar skills while providing additional physical and social benefits. Therefore, people can gain these advantages through healthier activities without spending too much time in front of a screen.
              The main concern is that video games can encourage addictive behaviour, especially among young people. Many games use scores, new targets and frequent rewards to motivate players to continue playing. As a result, children may spend more hours trying to complete levels or achieve higher scores than their friends. This can cause them to lose sleep, neglect their homework and spend less time for exercising. Over time, excessive gaming may affect their physical health and academic performance. Although playing games can provide enjoyment, these negative effects may have a more serious and lasting impact on their lives. Parents can help by setting reasonable time limits and encouraging children to take part in other activities.
             In conclusion, although video games can provide entertainment and help players develop certain skills, I believe their disadvantages are greater than their benefits. This is mainly because excessive gaming can damage people's health and interfere with their education, while similar benefits can be gained through other activities.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng câu hỏi, giữ rõ quan điểm hại nhiều hơn lợi và viết đủ 295 từ. Body 1 đã nêu hai lợi ích và hoạt động thay thế, nhưng em chưa triển khai ví dụ về những việc không thể làm ngoài đời, cảm giác mới lạ, và cách người chơi rèn kĩ năng qua chiến thuật. Body 2 có cơ chế điểm thưởng và ví dụ thi đua, song còn thiếu cảm giác đạt thành tựu và tác hại lên thị lực; câu về thời gian tập thể dục cũng dùng sai giới từ. reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, scientists and tourists can travel more easily to remote natural areas, including the South Pole. From my perspective, this is a positive development, provided that these visits are carefully managed to protect the environment.
               For tourists, travelling to remote areas offers unique experiences that are difficult to find in ordinary tourist destinations. Depending on the location, visitors may see rare plants and animals, try unfamiliar food or learn about local customs and ways of life. These experiences can help them understand different cultures and appreciate the natural world. Some people might argue that television programmes and online videos can provide similar information. However, watching something on a screen can not fully replace seeing it in person. Direct contact with nature can create stronger memories and give visitors a deeper understanding of the environment.
                More importantly, access to remote areas can bring significant benefits to scientific research. Scientists can study rare animals and their habitats to understand how climate change affects the natural world. They can also investigate unfamiliar diseases and prepare for possible health problems in the future. For example, research in isolated environments may help scientists discover important information about wildlife and environmental changes. Admittedly, an increase in tourism and research activities may disturb animals and damage fragile ecosystems. Nevertheless, this problem can be reduced if governments introduce strict rules, limit the number of visitors and ensure that scientific activities do not harm the environment. Therefore, the potential benefits can be achieved without causing unnecessary damage to nature.
In conclusion, I believe that allowing scientists and tourists to visit remote natural areas is a positive development because it provides valuable experiences and supports scientific research. However, careful management is essential to protect vulnerable ecosystems and ensure that these benefits can continue in the future.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ 296 từ, giữ quan điểm tích cực và chia đúng hai đoạn lợi ích cho khách du lịch, nhà khoa học. Đoạn du lịch có phản biện rõ với ý xem qua màn hình, nhưng ví dụ còn thiếu hòn đảo ít người biết và trải nghiệm tập tục bản địa. Đoạn khoa học mới nêu các hướng nghiên cứu chung; em cần viết rõ virus mới, tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu ở rừng và biển sâu, rồi nối chúng với việc phòng dịch và phục hồi môi trường sống. Em sửa hai chuỗi ý này và nộp lại bài.

annotations.label: a00
annotations.title: Diễn đạt lại đúng mức độ của đề
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Đề nói hiện nay có thể đến các vùng xa; “more easily” lại nói việc đi đã có từ trước và nay dễ hơn, là một nghĩa khác. Em giữ mốc “now” và ý “có thể đến”.

scientists and tourists can now reach remote natural areas

anchors.quote: scientists and tourists can travel more easily to remote natural areas

annotations.label: a01
annotations.title: Giữ trọng tâm quan điểm
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Điều kiện quản lý có thể hợp lý, nhưng phần này mở một hướng khác với hai lợi ích Cô giao và được lặp lại ở kết bài. Em nên nêu thẳng vì sao chuyến đi có lợi cho khách du lịch và nhà khoa học.

From my perspective, this is a positive development because these journeys offer tourists unfamiliar experiences and help scientists answer important questions.

anchors.quote: provided that these visits are carefully managed to protect the environment.

annotations.label: a02
annotations.title: Giải thích nhu cầu mới lạ
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Câu chủ đề đúng vai trò, nhưng em chưa giải thích rằng dù có nhiều điểm du lịch, người đi vẫn tìm sự mới lạ; đây là bước dẫn tới ví dụ hòn đảo xa lạ.

No matter how many attractions are available elsewhere, many travellers still crave novelty.

anchors.quote: For tourists, travelling to remote areas offers unique experiences that are difficult to find in ordinary tourist destinations.

annotations.label: a03
annotations.title: Làm đủ ví dụ du lịch
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Em đã có vài trải nghiệm đúng, nhưng ví dụ Cô giao còn hòn đảo ít người biết và việc tham gia tập tục tôn giáo của người bản địa. Thêm chúng để người đọc thấy điều mới lạ cụ thể đến từ đâu.

For example, on an island unknown to most people, visitors may take part in indigenous religious practices, see rarely seen plants and animals, try unfamiliar food and experience a different way of life.

anchors.quote: Depending on the location, visitors may see rare plants and animals, try unfamiliar food or learn about local customs and ways of life.

annotations.label: a04
annotations.title: Viết rõ đối tượng và phủ định
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Trong câu này nên viết “cannot” liền. “It” chưa gọi rõ điều đã xem, còn “seeing” không bao quát việc tham gia tập tục hoặc thử món ăn.

However, watching these experiences on a screen cannot fully replace taking part in them in person.

anchors.quote: However, watching something on a screen can not fully replace seeing it in person.

annotations.label: a05
annotations.title: Vận dụng câu bị động đúng chỗ
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Câu chủ động của em đúng. Để luyện cách nhấn mạnh hiện tượng được nghiên cứu, em có thể dùng bị động ở ví dụ về tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu, thay vì chỉ dùng bị động cho phần quản lý môi trường.

For example, the effects of global warming on elusive animals and their habitats in dense forests and deep-sea areas can be studied.

anchors.quote: Scientists can study rare animals and their habitats to understand how climate change affects the natural world.

annotations.label: a06
annotations.title: Ví dụ khoa học còn chung
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Câu này nhắc lại lợi ích nghiên cứu chứ chưa nêu hiện tượng cụ thể. Em cần chỉ ra virus mới và tác động nóng lên toàn cầu lên sinh vật ở rừng rậm, biển sâu, rồi nói hiểu biết ấy giúp phòng dịch và phục hồi môi trường sống.

For example, the effects of global warming on elusive animals and their habitats in dense forests and deep-sea areas can be studied, while unfamiliar viruses can be investigated. A better understanding of these phenomena may help scientists prepare for future outbreaks that could kill millions of people and show how damaged habitats can be restored.

anchors.quote: For example, research in isolated environments may help scientists discover important information about wildlife and environmental changes.

annotations.label: a07
annotations.title: Đoạn khoa học đi sang ý khác
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Các câu này bàn về tác hại và biện pháp quản lý, còn đoạn được giao là lợi ích nghiên cứu. Chúng chiếm chỗ của kết quả phòng dịch và phục hồi môi trường sống; câu quản lý ở kết bài cũng lặp hướng này. Em hãy dùng phần cuối đoạn để hoàn tất chuỗi khoa học.

A better understanding of these phenomena may help scientists prepare for future outbreaks that could kill millions of people and show how damaged habitats can be restored.

Therefore, the potential benefits can be achieved without causing unnecessary damage to nature.

Therefore” chuyển sang quản lý tác hại nên mạch lợi ích khoa học bị ngắt; “it” trong câu xem màn hình cũng chưa gọi rõ các trải nghiệm vừa nêu.
